pr.title: Fix egg-contract commands in per-agent worktrees
pr.description:
Add worktree path mapping to the gateway's contract API endpoints so that
egg-contract CLI commands work correctly from per-agent worktree containers.
Previously, contract endpoints didn't map container repo paths to worktree
paths, causing "Contract not found" errors when agents used add-decision
or add-feedback from their isolated worktrees.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: New tests in gateway/tests/test_contract_api.py for worktree mapping
- Manual: Run egg-contract add-decision from a per-agent worktree container and verify it succeeds
